Baby Long Legs.title: Baby Long Legs
Baby Long Legs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Baby Long Legs quickly run away from Isaac and occasionally stops to spawn a Spider. Usually, they can spawn a maximum of 3 Spiders. They run around erratically when Isaac is nearby and can sometimes run directly into him when this occurs.

sections.heading: Small Baby Long Legs
sections.text: The Small Baby Long Legs is a tiny variant of Baby Long Legs that simultaneously spawns Sacks along with a small puddle of slowing White Creep. The Sacks it spawns start at around half health and take a while to regenerate fully.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • If a Small Baby Long Legs attempts to spawn a Sack on top of an already spawned Sack, the newly spawned Sack will replace the previous one.

Crazy Long Legs.title: Crazy Long Legs
Crazy Long Legs.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Crazy Long Legs runs towards Isaac and stops to spit 8 medium range blood shots in an all directions.

sections.heading: Small Crazy Long Legs
sections.text: The Small Crazy Long Legs is a tiny variant of the Crazy Long Legs. It runs slightly slower towards Isaac and stops to spit medium range 4 blood shots in the diagonal directions.

Boil.title: Boil
Boil.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Boils start as small red spheres that slowly grow to full size. When at their full size, they can spurt out a cluster of blood shots at Isaac, similar to one of Monstro's attacks. Boils decrease in size when hit, but will regenerate to their full size until fully destroyed.

sections.heading: Gut
sections.text: Guts have a 5.71% chance to replace Boils and behave almost identically. Instead of disorganized blood shots, they fire singular Ipecac shots at Isaac that do not damage them.

sections.heading: Sack
sections.text:
[disambig msg: the enemy; the pickup; Sacks] 

Sacks don't shoot projectiles; instead, they periodically spawn a Spider when fully swollen. Therefore, damaging them will prevent them from spawning Spiders, making them easy to kill. They also regenerate much slower than Boils or Guts. They can commonly be found on the early floors.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Up to six spiders can be active at once.

• [Repentance] They can spawn in unique Curse Room layouts if Isaac has Voodoo Head. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Blue Boil
sections.text: Blue Boils are mainly spawned during the Hush fight. They spawn fully swollen and don't need to charge up like regular Boils. Instead of spraying clusters of blood shots, they fire either one blood shot, or three blood shots in a spread towards Isaac. They also regain their health 10x faster than regular Boils if they are damaged but not killed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Blue Boils that appear in regular rooms can be Champions.

• Blue Boils' shots deal a full heart of damage to Isaac.

• [Repentance] They can also appear in ??? with the use of Red Key or by entering doors unlocked with the Blue Key. [end edition note]

sections.heading: Gush
sections.text:
Gushes are stationary, being unable to do any form of damage. Instead, they continuously create slowing black creep around them that slowly expands infinitely in radius and can cover the entire room if left alive for long enough. Unlike other Boil variants, they do not shrink or regenerate.

Although the Black Creep is relatively harmless on its own, Tar Boys can use their special attack if Isaac is standing on the creep.

sections.heading: Pustule
sections.text: Pustules are stationary enemies that appear to grow out of the ground, unlike Boils they do not shrink when damaged and instead continuously swell in size. When destroyed at the smallest stages, they explode into a tiny puddle of red creep and don't spawn anything. When destroyed at the last 2 stages of swelling they spawn a Small Maggot and a small pool of Red Creep, and if not destroyed, they will burst into a Bloodfly and a slightly larger puddle of Red Creep.

sections.heading: Walking Boil
sections.text: Walking Boils act like Boils, but randomly wander around the room, can deal half a heart of contact damage, and don't shrink or regenerate.

sections.heading: Walking Gut
sections.text: Walking Guts act like Guts, but randomly wander around the room, can deal half a heart of contact damage, and don't shrink and regenerate.

sections.heading: Walking Sack
sections.text: Walking Sacks act like Sacks, but randomly wander around the room, can deal half a heart of contact damage, and don't shrink or regenerate.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• [Before Afterbirth+] While regular Boils can be touched without taking damage, champion forms do inflict one heart of damage on touch (like all champions).

• Champion Boils grow significantly slower but take more hits to deflate. The exception to this is gray champions, which grow faster and take fewer hits to deflate.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• Gushes were added in Booster Pack #4, after the initial release of the DLC.

• [Repentance] A pustule is the scientific name for a pimple.

• [Repentance] Pustules in Antibirth would burst into Small Maggots and puddles of Green Creep as opposed to the Bloodfly and Red Creep in Repentance.
